Name: Range Extender
Author: yshdmt
Description:
[b][size=3]Mod Overview[/size]:[/b]
Ever wanted to loot all Kegs with one click?
Refill one or all Kegs with the Ancient Fruits you're carrying?
Then this is the Mod for you!

Hold your item and click on any Keg you want, even if you're 20 tiles away.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/31778/31778-1740004752-1034678437.gif[/img]

Unlimited range on interaction:
[b]Default: [/b]Keg, Preserves Jar and Casks.
[b]Default Keybind:[/b] [b]K [/b][size=2](Interacts with all enabled objects with what you're carrying)[/size]
Configurable with [b]GenericModConfigMenu[/b]

[size=3]Supported objects[/size][b]:[/b]
[list]
[*]Keg
[*]Preserves Jar
[*]Cask
[*]Lightning Rod
[*]Bee House
[*]Furnace
[*]Cheese Press
[*]Loom
[*]Oil Maker
[*]Recycling Machine
[*]Crystalarium
[*]Mayonnaise Machine
[*]Seed Maker
[*]Slime Egg-Press
[*]Bone Mill
[*]Tapper
[*]Charcoal Kiln
[*]Slime Incubator
[*]Statue of Perfection
[*]Statue of Endless Fortune
[*]Geode Crusher
[*]Wood Chipper
[*]Worm Bin
[*]Coffee Maker
[*]Heavy Tapper
[*]Solar Panel
[*]Mushroom Log
[/list][size=3][b]Install:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Source:[/b][/size]
[url=https://github.com/YsEmei/RangeExtender/]GitHub[/url]
